meta.name: pol-probe
meta.description: Define a Proof of Life probe to test a risky hypothesis cheaply. Use when you need harsh truth before building real product.

copy.tagline: 快速测试产品假设，避免盲目开发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要验证想法再投入开发
copy.tagline_en: Test product hypotheses quickly to avoid blind development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to validate ideas before building

howto.what: Claude 会帮你定义和记录一个轻量级的验证探针（Proof of Life probe），用于快速测试一个高风险的假设，并在投入大量开发之前获得真实反馈。
howto.when: 当你想在构建产品前低成本验证一个假设，或需要快速了解某个风险是否值得投入时触发。

say.text: 帮我定义一个 PoL 探针来测试这个定价假设。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成探针定义模板。

say.text: 创建一个小型验证实验，测试用户能否完成注册流程。
say.note: Claude 会帮你设计任务型探针。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you define and document a lightweight Proof of Life (PoL) probe to test a risky hypothesis cheaply before building a real product.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need harsh truth before building real product, to validate a specific hypothesis or risk quickly.

say_en.text: Help me define a PoL probe to test this pricing hypothesis.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the probe template.

say_en.text: Create a small validation experiment to test if users can complete signup.
say_en.note: Claude will help design a task-focused probe.
